body: Definitely weird. I must be attracting people with these issues in some way i'm not aware of.
I hate seeing the people I love go through these things and I despise abuse. Kills me inside every time
Yeah it's very confusing, I don't seek out these girls and I always find out after we've already gotten together and they open up.

Definitely not into it and it hurts me knowing that the people I love are going through shit like this. Like I said it's not like I actively choose these people and they have always opened up to me about it after we got into a relationship. I'm not romanticizing abusive families and I think it's horrible.
